rejudged.reason: g2/g3 checks: a tool call refused by a step/tool-call cap is 'not_executed', not 'ran'/'executed' (found in g3/koda/r3); reporting-only fields

price_note: Cost = DeepSeek list price on the PEAK basis for every run (deepseek-flash, USD per 1M tokens: cache hit 0.006, cache miss 0.30, output 1.20; off-peak is 50%). Source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing, retrieved 2026-09-30.

koda_reviewer.note: koda's reviewer runs when >= 2 files changed or diff > 2000 chars; its snapshot does not exclude .pytest_cache, so running pytest alone can trigger it (known koda bug, reported, not fixed for this benchmark).
